requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current CBOT SRW COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; exact WHEAT-SRW futures-only disaggregated contract

requirements.requirement: daily/weekly WEAT issuer shares or holdings
requirements.policy: lawful issuer publications only; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥30 years of dated ONI history
requirements.policy: NOAA CPC official ONI; ENSO is context and cannot substitute for crop-region weather
reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series across commodity profiles; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of RUB, EUR, AUD, CAD and ARS against USD
requirements.policy: primary central-bank or lawful market history with exact FX bases; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current front-month CBOT SRW Wheat futures quote
requirements.policy: reuse the swarm pulse quote transport (`@W.1`); label it US¢/bu futures; no connector clone

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT SRW close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@W.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Corn close history aligned to wheat
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@C.1`; the wheat/corn ratio is one relative-demand cluster

requirements.requirement: current old-crop/new-crop CBOT settlements with ≥3 years of curve snapshots
requirements.policy: CME official or licensed settlements with exact contracts; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current SRW, HRW and HRS prices with grade and protein basis
requirements.policy: lawful CME/MGEX or licensed prices; never compare unaligned grades

requirements.requirement: current CBOT, MATIF and Black Sea export prices net of FX and freight
requirements.policy: lawful exchange and primary export quotations; Black Sea estimates require source dispersion

requirements.requirement: monthly; current point-in-time US and world supply/use tables
requirements.policy: USDA WAOB official XML; revisions retained; production cells are bridge inputs and cannot cast a second demand vote

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥10 years of major-exporter ending stocks and use
requirements.policy: USDA/IGC primary balance with China and inaccessible stocks shown separately; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: weekly in season; ≥10 years by class and state/region
requirements.policy: USDA NASS and equivalent primary crop reports with release vintage; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current plus ≥30 years of daily yield-weighted weather aligned to live crop stage
requirements.policy: primary meteorological observations/forecasts with geography, model run and expiry; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current acreage, yield and output by major origin with estimate dispersion
requirements.policy: USDA, Statistics Canada, ABARES, EU and other primary crop releases; do not duplicate WASDE balance signals

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥5 market years of sales, reductions/adjustments and shipments by destination
requirements.policy: USDA FAS primary data; use the non-overlapping All Wheat total and separate gross sales, net sales and physical shipment

requirements.requirement: current export bans/taxes, Black Sea capacity and verified rerouting
requirements.policy: primary government, customs and port evidence; start from pre-policy supply and do not recount production

requirements.requirement: current farm cash-cost and marginal export-parity range
requirements.policy: primary farm budgets/input prices and lawful freight/FX; separate observed price, model range and market expectation
